# <!--name-->github/free-disk-space<!--/name-->

[![usages](https://img.shields.io/badge/usages-white?logo=githubactions&logoColor=blue)](https://github.com/search?q=elastic%2Foblt-actions%2Fgithub%2Ffree-disk-space+%28path%3A.github%2Fworkflows+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yml+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yaml%29&type=code)
[![test-github-free-disk-space](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-github-free-disk-space.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-github-free-disk-space.yml)

<!--description-->
A configurable GitHub Action to free up disk space on an Ubuntu GitHub Actions runner.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Required | Default |
|-------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------|
| `android`               | Remove Android runtime                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `false`  | `true`  |
| `dotnet`                | Remove .NET runtime                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `false`  | `true`  |
| `haskell`               | Remove Haskell runtime                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `false`  | `true`  |
| `large-packages`        | Remove large misc. packages — includes azure-cli, Chrome, Firefox, PowerShell, mono, and the llvm-, php-, mongodb-, mysql-, dotnet- and aspnetcore- package families. Respects subject toggles: `dotnet: false` exempts .NET from this sweep. | `false`  | `true`  |
| `docker-images`         | Remove Docker images                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `false`  | `true`  |
| `preinstalled-runtimes` | Remove pre-installed runtimes (Node, Go, Python, Ruby). ⚠️ Workflows using actions/setup-node, setup-python, setup-go or setup-ruby will re-download their runtime, and a pinned version may not be available.                              | `false`  | `false` |
| `tool-cache`            | DEPRECATED — renamed to `preinstalled-runtimes`. Still honoured, and will keep working until v3.0.0; it prints a warning when used.                                                                                                           | `false`  | `false` |
| `swap-storage`          | Remove swap storage. ⚠️ Jobs that need swap may be killed under memory pressure, with no error mentioning this action — see https://github.com/lumbroso-commons/free-disk-space/issues/12. Off by default for that reason.                | `false`  | `false` |
<!--/inputs-->

## Usage

<!--usage action="elastic/oblt-actions/**" version="env:VERSION"-->
```yaml

on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/github/free-disk-space@v1
        with:
          swap-storage: false
      # ...
```
<!--/usage-->
